summary: Homeowner check scanning: homeowner_check_receipts (images, extracted facts, match evidence, duplicate keys, ledger/GL/deposit links) and homeowner_check_deposits (bank remote-deposit confirmation, bank line match); post_check_receipt_payment / check_receipt_commit_posting write the payment to the homeowner ledger with Tex. Prop. Code 209.0063 applications in a draft batch committed only after its GL entry posts. Adds account 1020 Undeposited Funds beside Operating Cash where a community has no undeposited account (zero balance) and the undeposited_funds account role. Creates no journal entry, ledger row or balance.

preflight.name: dependent tables exist (community_account_roles, chart_of_accounts, homeowner_transactions, homeowner_txn_applications, transaction_upload_batches, library_documents, journal_entries, bank_statement_transactions, ownership_tenures, property_ownerships)
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name IN ('community_account_roles','chart_of_accounts','homeowner_transactions','homeowner_txn_applications','transaction_upload_batches','library_documents','journal_entries','bank_statement_transactions','ownership_tenures','property_ownerships')

preflight.name: the 209.0063 step function exists (migration 469)
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND p.proname = 'payment_application_step'

preflight.name: check receipt tables not created yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name IN ('homeowner_check_receipts','homeowner_check_deposits')

preflight.name: no undeposited_funds role yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM community_account_roles WHERE role = 'undeposited_funds'

preflight.name: no community has two active Operating Cash (1000) accounts
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM (SELECT community_id FROM chart_of_accounts WHERE account_number = '1000' AND is_active AND NOT is_summary GROUP BY community_id HAVING count(*) > 1) d

preflight.name: communities that will receive 1020 Undeposited Funds (Operating Cash, no 1020, no undeposited account): 7 in production
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM chart_of_accounts c WHERE c.account_number = '1000' AND c.is_active AND NOT c.is_summary AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chart_of_accounts x WHERE x.community_id = c.community_id AND x.account_number = '1020') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chart_of_accounts x WHERE x.community_id = c.community_id AND x.account_name ILIKE '%undeposited%')

preflight.name: existing undeposited accounts that will be reused for the role (August Meadows 1020): 1 in production
preflight.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT community_id)::int FROM chart_of_accounts WHERE account_name ILIKE '%undeposited%' AND is_active AND NOT is_summary AND account_type = 'asset' AND normal_balance = 'debit'

preflight.name: no ledger row already claims to be a check receipt
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM homeowner_transactions WHERE raw_row_jsonb->>'source' = 'check_receipt'

preflight.name: no journal entry already uses a check receipt / deposit / return reference
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM journal_entries WHERE source_reference LIKE 'checkrcpt:%' OR source_reference LIKE 'chkdep:%' OR source_reference LIKE 'checkret:%'

expected_changes: community_account_roles role check also allows undeposited_funds.

chart_of_accounts: +7 rows, account 1020 Undeposited Funds (asset, debit, active) in the Operating Cash fund of each community with Operating Cash and no undeposited account. Zero balance; no journal entry.
community_account_roles: +8 rows (role undeposited_funds): the 7 new 1020 accounts and August Meadows' existing 1020.
New table homeowner_check_deposits (association_record) and homeowner_check_receipts (association_record), RLS on, service_role SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE only.

Duplicate keys: one receipt per front image and per MICR fingerprint (returned / voided excluded); one ledger row per receipt (homeowner_transactions expression index); one journal entry per receipt / deposit / return reference; one deposit per bank reference and per bank line.
New functions post_check_receipt_payment (SECURITY DEFINER, dry run by default) and check_receipt_commit_posting, service_role only.

verify.name: both tables exist
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name IN ('homeowner_check_receipts','homeowner_check_deposits')

verify.name: seven 1020 Undeposited Funds accounts were added
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM chart_of_accounts WHERE account_number = '1020' AND account_name = 'Undeposited Funds' AND description LIKE '%(mig 514)%'

verify.name: eight undeposited_funds roles, each on an active debit-normal Undeposited Funds asset account
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM community_account_roles r JOIN chart_of_accounts a ON a.id = r.account_id WHERE r.role = 'undeposited_funds' AND a.account_name ILIKE '%undeposited%' AND a.account_type = 'asset' AND a.normal_balance = 'debit' AND a.is_active

verify.name: each new 1020 sits in its community's Operating Cash fund
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM chart_of_accounts n JOIN chart_of_accounts o ON o.community_id = n.community_id AND o.account_number = '1000' WHERE n.account_number = '1020' AND n.description LIKE '%(mig 514)%' AND n.fund_id IS DISTINCT FROM o.fund_id

verify.name: no activity on the new accounts (zero balance)
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM journal_entry_lines l JOIN chart_of_accounts a ON a.id = l.account_id WHERE a.account_number = '1020' AND a.description LIKE '%(mig 514)%'

verify.name: duplicate-key indexes exist (image, MICR, ledger row per receipt, GL reference, bank line)
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND indexname IN ('uq_check_receipt_front_image','uq_check_receipt_micr','uq_homeowner_txn_check_receipt','uq_journal_entries_check_refs','uq_check_deposit_bank_line')

verify.name: both functions exist; the posting function is SECURITY DEFINER
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND p.prosecdef AND p.proname IN ('post_check_receipt_payment','check_receipt_commit_posting')

verify.name: service_role can write the receipts; anon cannot read them
verify.sql: SELECT (has_table_privilege('service_role', 'public.homeowner_check_receipts', 'INSERT') AND NOT has_table_privilege('anon', 'public.homeowner_check_receipts', 'SELECT') AND has_table_privilege('service_role', 'public.homeowner_check_deposits', 'INSERT') AND NOT has_table_privilege('anon', 'public.homeowner_check_deposits', 'SELECT'))::int

verify.name: the full bank account number has no column (last 4 + fingerprint only)
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'homeowner_check_receipts' AND column_name IN ('account_number','micr_account','bank_account_number')
